snippet.title: Wasteland Kitchen Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195920/Wasteland_Kitchen

Prepare to run your very own restaurant in the post-apocalyptic wasteland!
Serve "meat" made from rats (or your customers)

This game is a little side project I decided to put together in Unreal Engine 5, it's been an idea I've wanted to test for a while and I'm happy how it's turned out so far! It blends together physics-based gameplay, base building, cooking mechanics and a dash of fps (first person shooter) combat! It's a weird mix, I know.
